W.note: Cream-on-navy hero is well composed and the glow is a cheap pre-blurred layer with a 1.2-overshoot lift and a 700ms tail, but the glow is faint, the hover capture shows the disabled Saturday button instead of an enabled one, and the lab copy ("Rebound ... a different reading") is confusing.

X.note: Four distinct curves drive a violet-rose aura that breathes while hovered plus a 1.2s sheen sweep over a lavender palette, which reads dreamy, though the infinite aura animation and the glossy sweep cost more and the Save pills are small on tiles.

Y.note: Best-practice build: a 240ms ease-land face, 680ms ease-tail glow, hover gated to hover-capable pointers, keyboard parity at half lift, a real reduced-motion path and a visible dreamlike toggle, but the violet glow is restrained and the duplicated id attribute and demo lab add clutter.

Z.note: The gradient that slides from violet to rose with a 1.4s drift, a sky-and-rose halo, a text glow and a heart bloom gives the most ethereal hover, while animating letter-spacing, background-position and filter makes it heavier to render and the focus state has no lift.
